mapper.update: UPDATE p0_run SET lease_owner = #{owner}, lease_expires_at = clock_timestamp() + (#{leaseSeconds} * interval '1 second'), heartbeat_at = clock_timestamp(), fence = fence + 1, status = 'CLAIMED', updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE execution_id = #{executionId}
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM p0_run WHERE execution_id = #{executionId} AND fence = #{fence} AND lease_owner = #{owner} AND lease_expires_at > clock_timestamp()
mapper.update: UPDATE p0_run SET status = #{status}, fence = fence + 1, error_code = 'WORKER_LOST', error_message = 'Lease expired; uncertain execution requires reconciliation', updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE execution_id = #{executionId} AND lease_expires_at < clock_timestamp()

UPDATE p0_run SET status = #{run.status}, started_at = coalesce(started_at, CAST(#{startedAt,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS timestamptz)), heartbeat_at = clock_timestamp(), lease_expires_at = clock_timestamp() + (#{leaseSeconds} * interval '1 second'), updated_at = clock_timestamp(), runtime_event_cursor = #{run.runtimeEventCursor}, result = #{run.result,jdbcType=OTHER,typeHandler=com.enterprise.platform.infrastructure.persistence.JsonNodeTypeHandler}, checkpoint_id = #{run.checkpointId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, error_code = #{run.errorCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, error_message = #{run.errorMessage,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE execution_id = #{run.executionId} AND fence = #{fence} AND lease_owner = #{owner} AND lease_expires_at > clock_timestamp()
